name: FalconBeat
author: GraphicHealer
description: Falcon Player plugin that broadcasts a light show's audio and now-playing info to a FalconBeat server.

privacy.summary: Sends your show audio files and play/pause commands to the FalconBeat server address you configure, so visitors' can play the show audio from their own devices in perfect sync.

sends.what: show audio files, playback commands, room admin secret
sends.why: to let visitors' devices stream the show audio in sync with the lights

systemChanges.what: runs a background Python daemon (falconbeatd) while fppd is running; listens only on a local unix socket
sets FPP's restartFlag on install/upgrade so fppd restarts and loads the new plugin code

privacy.other: Your secrets are stored under plugindata mode 0600, not in the shared config directory. The daemon's local control channel is a unix socket; nothing listens on the network.
